title: Making Arrangements by Email
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Ahora puedes redactar y comprender correos electrónicos básicos para organizar reuniones, confirmar citas y hacer seguimiento.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Correos para Organizar Reuniones

parts.visual: Estructura de un email de negocios: Saludo (Dear Mr. Smith / Hi John,). Cuerpo (I am writing to... / I would like to...). Cierre (Best regards / Kind regards / Yours sincerely).
parts.audio: Business email structure: Greeting: Dear Mr Smith or Hi John. Body: I am writing to, or I would like to. Closing: Best regards, Kind regards, or Yours sincerely.

parts.visual: Frases clave: I am writing to confirm the meeting (Escribo para confirmar la reunión). Are you available on Monday at 10 AM? (¿Estás disponible el lunes a las 10?). Please let me know (Hágame saber / Avísame).
parts.audio: Key phrases: I am writing to confirm the meeting. Are you available on Monday at ten AM? Please let me know.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la expresión correcta para emails de negocios.

questions.question: How do you start a formal email? (Saludo formal).
I am ____ to confirm our meeting. (Escribo para...).
Please ____ me know your availability. (Hágame saber).
questions.explanation: Please let me know = hágame saber / avíseme.

questions.question: I ____ like to schedule a call. (Me gustaría).
questions.explanation: I would like to = me gustaría.

questions.question: How do you close a formal email? (Cierre formal).
questions.explanation: Cierre formal: Best regards / Kind regards.

questions.question: I am ____ you this email to arrange a meeting. (Enviando).
questions.explanation: I am sending you this email.

questions.question: Could you please ____ your attendance? (Confirmar).
questions.explanation: Confirm your attendance = confirmar tu asistencia.

questions.question: Would ____ at 3 PM work for you? (El martes).
questions.explanation: Would Tuesday at 3 PM work for you?

questions.question: I look ____ to hearing from you. (Espero con interés).
questions.explanation: I look forward to = espero con interés.

questions.question: I am ____ to your previous email. (Respondiendo a).
I hope this email finds you ____. (Bien).
questions.explanation: I hope this email finds you well = saludo estándar.

questions.question: I ____ the meeting has been rescheduled. (Entendí).
Please feel ____ to contact me. (Siéntase libre).
questions.explanation: Please feel free to contact me.

questions.question: I will ____ you the agenda. (Enviaré).
questions.explanation: I will send you the agenda.

questions.question: Please ____ this email to John. (Reenvíe).
questions.explanation: Forward this email = reenviar este correo.

questions.question: I will be in ____. (Fuera de la oficina).
questions.explanation: Out of the office = fuera de la oficina.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra o frase correcta para emails de negocios.

questions.question: I would ____ to schedule a call. (Me gustaría).
I look ____ to hearing from you.

pairs.source: I look forward to hearing from you
Please feel free to contact me

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am writing to confirm the meeting.
options: I am writing to confirm the meeting.
She is writing to confirm the meeting.
I am writing to cancel the meeting.
I write to confirm the meeting.
questions.correct_answer: I am writing to confirm the meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Are you available on Monday at ten AM?
options: Are you available on Monday at ten AM?
Is she available on Monday at ten AM?
Are you available on Tuesday at ten AM?
Are you free on Monday at ten AM?
questions.correct_answer: Are you available on Monday at ten AM?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please let me know your availability.
options: Please let me know your availability.
Please let her know your availability.
Please let me know your schedule.
questions.correct_answer: Please let me know your availability.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I would like to schedule a call.
options: I would like to schedule a call.
She would like to schedule a call.
I would like to arrange a call.
I want to schedule a call.
questions.correct_answer: I would like to schedule a call.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I look forward to hearing from you.
options: I look forward to hearing from you.
She looks forward to hearing from you.
I look forward to speaking with you.
I look forward to your reply.
questions.correct_answer: I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I hope this email finds you well.
options: I hope this email finds you well.
I hope this message finds you well.
She hopes this email finds you well.
I hope this email found you well.
questions.correct_answer: I hope this email finds you well.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please feel free to contact me.
options: Please feel free to contact me.
Please feel free to call me.
You can feel free to contact me.
Please feel free to email me.
questions.correct_answer: Please feel free to contact me.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I will be out of the office tomorrow.
options: I will be out of the office tomorrow.
She will be out of the office tomorrow.
I am out of the office tomorrow.
I will be away from the office tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: I will be out of the office tomorrow.
